span.p:
⚠️ PAPER DESIGN — nothing built
The AWS gateway diagram is a build record.
This one is drawn from documentation only.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
managed-settings.json
forceLoginMethod · forceLoginGatewayUrl
managed-only keys, pushed by MDM
identical to the AWS deployment;
only the URL differs

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Claude Code
an IdP session, and nothing else
no GCP credential on the machine

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1 · 2 - sign in, session minted
accounts.google.com · /oauth/callback
scopes: openid, profile, email
allowed_email_domains gates sign-in

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
⚠️ id_tokens carry no groups claim
oidc.google_groups queries the Admin SDK
via a service-account key file with
domain-wide delegation
without it, one policy per email domain
a non-issue on Okta or Entra

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3 - reaching the gateway
internal Application Load Balancer
internal DNS name and certificate
*.run.app is public, so /login's
private-address check rejects it
set trusted_proxies, or audit lines
record the balancer, not the developer

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Secret Manager - four secrets
config · jwt · oidc secret · pg url

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Service account - no static keys
roles/aiplatform.user
ADC on Cloud Run or Workload Identity

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
claude gateway
image from Artifact Registry
Cloud Run ingress internal, or GKE
--timeout=3600, or streams cut at 300s
Direct VPC egress to Cloud SQL
⚠️ org policy can force the GKE track

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL 16
private IP · sslmode=require
sessions, spend limits, audit
boot is fail-closed after 5s

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4 - inference · Agent Platform
provider: vertex · project · region
claude-opus-4-8 · claude-sonnet-4-6
first-party ids, no us.anthropic.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Residency - three tiers
global: no premium
multi-region us or eu: 10%
regional: 10%, one named region
⚠️ regional serves Sonnet 4.6 and older
one region costs models, not just 10%

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Retention - unlike Bedrock
~24h cache on by default; turn it off
with disableCache on the project
⚠️ no fail-closed, no allowed_modes,
no source field, no Org Policy lock

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Policy, enforced server-side
availableModels + enforceAvailableModels
permissions.deny · desktop: {}
keyed on IdP group, at the managed tier
identical to AWS - the claude binary,
not the cloud

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Audit - one JSON line each
device.authorize · session.mint
managed.serve · inference
the only per-developer record - the
cloud sees one service account

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
⚠️ Cloud Audit Logs - default inverts
prediction calls are DATA_READ, so they
land in Data Access logs, off by default
on AWS the CloudTrail record needs no
opt-in; here it must be enabled first
